CommunityApplications.Profile:
BisqFTS: Bisq, the decentralized bitcoin exchange, in a container used from a web browser or a VNC client. The image installs the official Bisq release after verifying its PGP signature against pinned signer fingerprints, and GitHub Actions builds new Bisq releases automatically.
Source, documentation and support: https://github.com/jaclas/bisqfts (please report problems as GitHub issues).
